description: This Council has been asked for its observations on an application submitted to Westminster City Council (26/04718/FULL) for: Demolition of Grove House, 28-32 Hereford Road, 38 Hereford Road and 1-9 Hereford Mews and redevelopment of the site to provide a replacement six storey block on Westbourne Grove comprising commercial floorspace (Class E) at ground floor level and residential (Class C3) on upper levels; a replacement part four storey, part five storey residential (Class C3) block on Hereford Road; three storey dwellings (Class C3) onto remodelled Hereford Mews; erection of roof extension onto no. 86 Westbourne Grove to provide additional residential floorspace (Class C3); refurbishment of no.96 Westbourne Grove; construction of double storey basement across the site to provide commercial floorspace (Class E) and ancillary residential floorspace (Class C3); associated parking, cycle parking and landscaping works; public realm improvements; and other associated works (For the purposes of consultation: affordable housing required by the proposals is proposed to be provided in the redevelopment proposals at 21-31 Woodfield Road, W9 being assessed under application 26/04720/FULL)
site_name: Development Site At 84-96 Westbourne Grove, 26-28 And 28A Hereford Road And 1-9, Hereford Mews, London
